description: Date and time at which the sample reading was recorded; generated at 20-minute intervals.
Pseudonymous synthetic patient identifier; does not identify a real person.
Heart-rate sample in beats per minute (BPM). Synthetic readings may include out-of-range examples for testing.
Body temperature sample in degrees Celsius.
Peripheral oxygen saturation sample expressed as a percentage.
Communication channel label associated with the sample: WiFi or Bluetooth.
Rule-based flag: 1 if heart rate <60 or >100 BPM, SpO2 <95%, temperature <36.0°C or >37.5°C; otherwise 0. Not a diagnosis.
